name: 夜幕声浪舒适真无线耳机款

category.leaf: 夜幕声浪舒适真无线耳机

description: 夜幕光轨沉浸开场、声浪微距与亲肤佩戴主线的真无线耳机详情套图

styleLock.backgroundSystem: 深浅交替分区：深藏蓝夜幕底（含细弱光轨）与浅灰摄影棚面板交替出现
styleLock.lightingSystem: 顶部前方柔和漫射主光，暗场加冷蓝轮廓光且整体低调，亮场高调干净，均带轻柔接触投影
styleLock.surfaceSystem: 哑光摄影棚台面：暗场为哑光深蓝夜幕，亮场为浅灰净面
styleLock.typography: 现代几何无衬线体；「」包裹的短标题文案槽；参数大数字加粗放大；禁衬线、手写、卡通体
styleLock.iconSystem: 2px 细线图标，雾紫蓝 #6F7FD6，圆形徽章容器，低复杂度
styleLock.presentationRules: 产品居中稳定、全套比例一致；开舱微俯 3/4 为惯用主角度，微距/俯视/低角度穿插换节奏；双色对比镜必须同机位同光
noDrift: no product scale drift between shots
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool night-tech ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep navy night backdrop #0B1020, clean light-grey panel #F4F5F7, soft white #FFFFFF, charcoal text #2D2D2D, and one periwinkle-blue accent #6F7FD6; cool temperature; modern geometric sans-serif headlines with short copy slots wrapped in 「」; alternating deep-navy night backdrops with subtle sweeping light streaks and clean light-grey studio panels; soft diffused studio key light from top-front with a cool blue rim glow on dark screens and gentle contact shadows; consistent thin-line icon system with 2px strokes in the accent blue and rounded circular badges; clean rounded-rectangle info labels; product always centered with stable scale and a consistent hero angle; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 夜幕光轨里开舱亮相见，一秒立住沉浸听感并赢下点击
shots.camera: 高机位约30°俯视带轻微3/4转角，充电仓开盖立起、双耳塞在位，置于画面下半部
shots.lighting: 低调冷调棚拍：顶部前方柔主光 + 沿仓体边缘的冷蓝轮廓光，仓下轻接触投影
shots.background: 深藏蓝夜幕底 #0B1020，细弱扫掠光轨，边缘轻微暗角
shots.textZone: 顶部约30%为软白大标题区与一行副标题条，右缘一条竖排短卖点小字带
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic hero banner of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose: dramatic night-style opening screen that sets an immersive listening mood in one second. Composition: {product} in the lower half of the frame filling 50-60% of the frame, charging case open with lid raised and both earbuds seated, photographed from a high 30-degree angle looking down at a slight 3/4 turn. Lighting: low-key cool studio lighting, soft top-front key with a cool blue rim glow along the case edges, soft contact shadow grounding the case. Background: deep navy night backdrop #0B1020 with subtle sweeping light streaks and a soft darker vignette. Props: none, abstract light trails only. Text zone: the top 30% of the frame carries one large headline in soft white #FFFFFF reading 「{callout_1}」, a short subtitle row below reading 「{selling_point_1}」, and a slim vertical short-label strip on the right edge reading 「{selling_point_2}」, completing one balanced composition. 2K, commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no brand logos, no wordmarks, no watermarks, no garbled or extra text, no hands, no floating product without contact shadow, no warm color cast, no cluttered props, no cut-off product edges.

shots.intent: 一屏六条细线图标卖点，快速建立全能型认知
shots.camera: 平面直视排版构图，本屏无实拍产品
shots.lighting: 纯图形屏，均匀无影；图标无投影
shots.props: 六枚细线图标（雾紫蓝 #6F7FD6），2x3 网格排布
shots.whitespace: about 15% outer panel margins around the badge-and-grid layout, keeping the screen airy
shots.textZone: 顶部居中胶囊徽章一行 + 居中大标题 + 2x3 图标网格，每格一枚图标下配 4-6 字短标签
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic feature-grid screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose: communicate six core selling points in one glance. Layout: flat straight-on graphic composition with a small rounded pill badge at top center reading 「{callout_1}」, one large headline below reading 「{callout_2}」, then a 2x3 grid of thin-line icons in accent blue #6F7FD6, each cell carrying a 4-6 character short label reading 「{selling_point_1}」「{selling_point_2}」「{selling_point_3}」「{selling_point_4}」「{selling_point_5}」「{selling_point_6}」 in charcoal #2D2D2D; the grid holds about 15% outer panel margins so the screen reads airy and balanced. No product photo in this screen; icons and labels only. Background: clean light-grey panel #F4F5F7, even shadowless graphic lighting. 2K, commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no product photo, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no dense body text, no garbled characters, no drop shadows on icons, no mixed icon styles.

shots.intent: 单耳微距配声波弧线，把音质降噪卖点具象成可见声场
shots.camera: 微距特写：45°顶侧机位紧贴单只耳塞，浅景深，前景清晰
shots.lighting: 低调冷调：侧向柔光扫过哑光表面显露质感与接缝，冷蓝轮廓光
shots.background: 深藏蓝夜幕底 #0B1020，边缘轻微暗角
shots.props: 耳塞两侧各一组细同心声波弧线（雾紫蓝 #6F7FD6 平面图形叠加）
shots.whitespace: minimal, detail is the whole point
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro detail shot of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose: make sound quality tangible as a visible sound field. Composition: tight zoom on one single earbud photographed at a 45-degree top-side angle, shallow depth of field with the foreground earbud sharp, detail occupies 55-60% of frame with only minimal margins because the texture detail is the whole point. Lighting: low-key cool lighting, soft side key raking across the matte surface to reveal finish and seams, cool blue rim glow. Background: deep navy night backdrop #0B1020 with a subtle darker vignette. Props: thin concentric sound-wave arcs in accent blue #6F7FD6 flanking the earbud as flat graphic overlays. Text zone: none. 2K, commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no blurry subject, no duplicated earbud parts, no garbled text, no watermark, no fake logo, no hands, no floating product without grounding shadow.

shots.intent: 用硅胶耳帽与轻巧无感标签正面回应久戴胀痛顾虑
shots.camera: 高机位45°正俯视开仓，耳塞在位，产品居右偏中
shots.lighting: 亮调棚拍：顶部前方柔主光，仓下轻接触投影
shots.textZone: 顶部大标题一行与一行小副标；左缘两枚圆形细线图标徽章，各配短标签与小字副标
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic comfort screen of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose: answer the long-wear soreness concern with a soft-fit proof. Composition: {product} shown as an open charging case with earbuds seated, photographed from a high 45-degree overhead angle looking down, placed right of center and filling 60-70% of the frame as the anchor of one balanced layout. Lighting: bright soft studio key from top-front, gentle contact shadow under the case. Background: clean light-grey panel #F4F5F7. Props: none. Text zone: top strip with one large headline reading 「{callout_1}」 and a one-line subhead reading 「{selling_point_1}」 in charcoal #2D2D2D; along the left edge two circular thin-line icon badges in accent blue #6F7FD6, each with a short label reading 「{selling_point_2}」 and 「{selling_point_3}」 plus a small one-line sublabel. 2K, commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no hands, no ears, no watermark, no fake logo, no garbled text, no dense body text, no floating product, no mixed icon styles.

shots.intent: 做工质感短文案配两个大数字参数，用看得见的工艺打消品质疑虑
shots.camera: 低机位微仰直视合盖充电仓正面，产品居下半部居中
shots.lighting: 均匀明亮棚拍：顶部前方柔光，轻柔接触投影
shots.textZone: 居中大标题 + 两行短副标；产品上方两个并排大数字参数块（数字加单位加小标签）
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic craft-and-stats screen of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose: prove build quality with a tactile claim and two big numbers. Composition: {product} shown as a closed charging case photographed from a low angle looking slightly upward, straight-on front view, centered in the lower half and filling 60-70% of the frame as the anchor of one balanced layout. Lighting: bright even studio light from top-front with a soft contact shadow. Background: near-white clean panel #FAFAFA. Props: none. Text zone: centered large headline reading 「{callout_1}」, a two-line short subhead reading 「{selling_point_1}」, then two side-by-side large stat blocks above the product in accent blue #6F7FD6 reading 「{selling_point_2}」 and 「{selling_point_3}」 with small unit-and-label lines in charcoal #2D2D2D, completing the composition. 2K, commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no invented test data, no fake certifications, no garbled text, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo, no hands, no cut-off product edges.

shots.intent: 尺寸标注加参数表一次讲清多大配什么，消除下单疑问
shots.camera: 平视轻微3/4正面开仓，居上半部居中，仓旁一条细竖向尺寸标注线
shots.lighting: 柔漫射棚光 + 冷蓝轮廓光，仓下轻接触投影
shots.textZone: 顶部居中标题；中部尺寸标注线一条带数值标签；下部两列参数表，细分隔线、左标签右值
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic size-and-spec screen of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose: kill size and compatibility doubts in one structured screen. Composition: {product} shown as an open charging case at a slight 3/4 front angle, eye-level, centered in the upper half filling 50-60% of the frame, with one thin vertical dimension callout line beside it labeled 「{callout_2}」, so the screen reads as one complete structured layout. Lighting: soft diffused studio light with a cool blue rim glow, gentle contact shadow. Background: deep navy night backdrop #0B1020. Props: none. Text zone: top center headline reading 「{callout_1}」 in soft white #FFFFFF; below the product a two-column spec table with thin divider lines, left labels and right values reading 「{selling_point_1}」「{selling_point_2}」「{selling_point_3}」「{selling_point_4}」「{selling_point_5}」「{selling_point_6}」 in soft white #FFFFFF. 2K, commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no dense body text, no garbled characters, no serial numbers, no fake certificates, no watermark, no fake logo, no hands.

shots.intent: 同机位同光并列两款深色系配色，让买家一眼锁定自己的颜色
shots.camera: 双仓并排，均平视直视正面，两单元机位、比例、灯光完全一致
shots.lighting: 与主视觉一致的低调冷调棚光，两单元受光完全对称
shots.background: 深藏蓝夜幕底 #0B1020，细弱光轨
shots.textZone: 每单元下方一行配色名标签
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant comparison screen of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose: let buyers lock onto their colorway instantly. Composition: two identical open charging cases side by side, both photographed straight-on at eye level with identical angle, scale and lighting; left unit in a deep navy-blue finish #1C2440, right unit in a matte black finish #17181C, both units occupy 60-70% of frame overall so the pair fills the frame as one balanced composition. Background: deep navy night backdrop #0B1020 with subtle light streaks. Props: none. Text zone: one short colorway label line under each unit reading 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in soft white #FFFFFF. 2K, commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no mixed lighting between units, no color drift between the two units, no QR code, no membership badges, no watermark, no fake logo, no garbled text, no hands.

shots.intent: 以标准套装与保修服务标签收尾，最后拆掉下单顾虑
shots.camera: 平视直视合盖充电仓，居中于画面中段
shots.lighting: 亮调高调棚拍：顶部前方均匀柔光，轻柔接触投影
shots.props: 产品下方三枚细线信任徽章（雾紫蓝 #6F7FD6）
shots.textZone: 顶部居中标题一行；产品下方一排三枚徽章各配短标签（保修/服务/套装信息走文案槽）
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust closing screen of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose: remove the last purchase risk with service and package assurances. Composition: {product} shown as a closed charging case, photographed straight-on at eye level, centered in the middle band filling 50-60% of the frame as the anchor of one balanced layout, with a soft contact shadow. Lighting: bright even high-key studio light from top-front. Background: clean light-grey panel #F4F5F7. Props: below the product a row of three thin-line trust badges in accent blue #6F7FD6. Text zone: top center headline reading 「{callout_1}」 in charcoal #2D2D2D; three short labels under the badges reading 「{selling_point_1}」「{selling_point_2}」「{selling_point_3}」, each stating one warranty, service or package fact supplied through the copy slots. 2K, commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, awards, ratings or test data; no certificate artwork, no fake logos, no QR code, no watermark, no garbled text, no hands.

provenance.notes: 源为 800x1200 详情页长图 6 张切片（相邻重叠60px）逐一识图；主产品为入耳式真无线蓝牙耳机+鹅卵石充电仓，与源文件名『耳机 (13)』相符。已剥离：画面左缘英文品牌字、规格表中的素材站水印行、右下角会员二维码促销浮层及全部原图文案（标题/卖点均以「」文案槽重建）。与库内既有 4 份音频模版差异化：既有真无线款走悬浮开场/触控/连稳对比主线，本款辨识点为夜幕光轨开场、声浪弧线微距、亲肤佩戴主线、大数字参数看板与深浅交替分区，双色为深藏蓝/磨砂黑。收口 TRUST 镜由源规格表中的套餐/售后服务行改写为可由使用方填写的服务/套装文案槽，未新增源图中不存在的事实。
